selection: No Go facts or renderer/CSS/storage implementation changed. Check checker failures, smoke failures, local loading and affected cheatsheet layout. No full historical browser/Go rerun.

structure.scope: Syntax and structural checks only; not Go correctness, translation equivalence, UI or automatic review completion.

unit_tests.coverage: Current corpus; malformed collections; duplicate IDs; null row/step; broken references; answer index; incomplete translation/practice/step answer; diff changes/removals/order; invalid JavaScript.

smoke.scope: Shared smoke only. No Go correctness, targeted translation/content checks, visual review or broad regression.

result.scope: Shared smoke only. No Go correctness, targeted translation/content checks, visual review or broad regression.

negative_cases.initial_validator: Detected existing sparse array entry in CHEATSHEET_ROWS; removed only the extra comma.
negative_cases.test_development: Initial partial-answer fixture assumed first step had a check; corrected to select a step that actually has a check. Initial temporary browser probe used incorrect tbody selector; corrected using app.js before final pass.
negative_cases.sandbox: New browser script initially blocked from localhost; rerun with approved permission succeeded.

content_comparison: Cards, quiz and simulators exactly equal base. Current cheatsheet equals base with empty entry removed: same 12 rendered rows. Asset version v15.
limitations: Structural checker is intentionally partial; does not establish Go correctness, EN/RU meaning or all nested schema constraints.
Shared smoke does not replace targeted scenarios or broad UI/storage regressions.
Targeted checks include cheatsheet 320/390/430/1440 px and 200% text; no visual design changed and no screenshot review claimed.
No new Go tests, live publication verification, physical device or screen reader checks.
Times are individual local warm-browser observations, excluding startup and editorial work; no end-to-end speedup claim.
